task:
Colony Planner S5c: economy bars on /plan (the UI half of slice S5). apps/web plus one design-doc edit. No backend change, no migration.

CONTEXT ON MAIN:
- S5a (#955) added the economy calculation to the `cpe` core; S5b (#967) made `GET /api/v1/plan/systems/{id}/bodies` return economy facts from the published derived generation and `POST /api/v1/plan/evaluate` return `economies { now, after_plan, notes }` — each port lists its economies with a full breakdown (own, strong-link, passed-on, planetary-port and weak-link contributions) and the economy rule ids (RB-0009 … RB-0020, RB-0027) appear in `explanations`. #967 says "There is no UI yet; the bars are S5c."
- `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-30-v3-colony-planner-design.md` §7 lists S5 as one row; `docs/ROADMAP.md` "Where things stand" notes the S5c split is not yet documented.
- The /plan page lives under `apps/web/src/lib/features/plan/` (SystemPane, SlotEditor, BuildOrder, WhyDrawer, FacilityPicker, plan.css) and uses the generated facade in `apps/web/src/lib/api/`.

WHAT TO DO:
1. Design doc: in §7 replace the single S5 row with S5a (core calculation), S5b (facts + evaluate contract) and S5c (bars UI) rows, each marked as shipped/this PR, keeping the RB references; add one short paragraph defining S5c's contract: bars read only the evaluate response, show `now` vs `after_plan` per port, never compute economies client-side, and state plainly when economy facts are unavailable for the system.
2. UI: for each port in the plan (Primary Port first, then the others in build order) render an **economy bar**: a horizontal stacked bar of the port's economies by share, with the economy name, percentage and a legend; two rows per port — "Now" and "After plan" — so the commander sees what the plan changes; highlight economies that appear/disappear/change by more than a threshold. Each segment is keyboard-focusable and announces its breakdown (own / strong link / passed on / planetary port / weak link) in an accessible tooltip or disclosure, and links the rule ids to the existing Why drawer (clicking an economy opens the drawer filtered to its RB rules).
3. Honest states: when the bodies route returned no economy facts for this generation (all economy fields null), show "Economy facts unavailable for this system's published generation" with no bars; when evaluate returns `notes`, show them; a port with no economies shows "No economy" rather than an empty bar; never invent percentages — if the breakdown does not sum to 100 %, show the shares as returned and a note.
4. Colours: use the design-kit tokens if present on main (`--accent`, `--neon`, `--ok`, `--warn`, `--text-muted` in `apps/web/src/app.css`), otherwise the existing plan.css palette; one stable colour per economy kind defined in a single map; must pass axe (contrast) in the Cypress plan journey.
5. Tests: component tests for the bar (shares, now-vs-after diffing, unavailable state, notes, keyboard focus and tooltip text, Why-drawer linkage); extend the existing /plan Cypress journey with one bar assertion and an axe check; keep existing plan tests passing. `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.
6. CHANGES.md entry at the top ("Colony Planner S5c: economy bars"); update the ROADMAP "Planner next" bullet to say S5c is implemented and the split is documented. Visual change: needs Product E2E/visual validation before promotion; not deployed.
